name: FloraMedica: Plant ID & Traditional Pharmacopoeia
description: Offline medicinal plants identification and ethnomedicine database with camera stream scanner, multi-frame plant grouping estimation, population statistics and biodiversity survey, user feedback and taxonomic ground-truth verification mechanism for AI model fine-tuning, medicinal taxonomy (Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa, Ayurveda), edibility safety index, interactive 3D plant morphology, standalone Windows Desktop & Android APK downloads, and dedicated marketing portal at floraMedica.stpaul2coderdojo.github.io.
